synonyms: Tenkosaki: The Neat and Pretty Girl at My New School Is a Childhood Friend of Mine Who I Thought Was a Boy
anilist.description:
Seven years after making a childhood promise to always be friends, Hayato is reunited with his formerly tomboyish pal Haruki at a city high school–only now, Haruki has transformed into the girl every guy dreams about! While Haruki’s looks may have changed, with Hayato, she’s still the same pal he remembers. Despite years apart, their promise and feelings remain and deepen into something stronger.

(Source: Crunchyroll)

episodes.title: Beginning with a Summer Day
episodes.overview: Childhood buddies Hayato and Haruki are reunited when Hayato moves to Tokyo and sees Haruki at his new school.

episodes.title: I Really Suck at Girl Talk

titles.en: I Really Suck at Girl Talk

episodes.overview: As the two old friends continue to get reacquainted, Haruki starts teasing Hayato for not owning a cell phone.

episodes.title: Produced by Himeko
episodes.overview: Himeko meets Haruki for the first time in years and decides to take her shopping to help update her wardrobe.

episodes.title: Small Hands, Broad Shoulders
episodes.overview: Hayato and Haruki go phone shopping together and then Haruki ends up spending the night at Hayato's apartment.

episodes.title: Discipline, Young Maiden
episodes.overview: Himeko and Haruki decide to go on a diet, so Hayato starts asking friends for health-conscious recipe ideas.

episodes.title: What About Your Camouflage?!
episodes.overview: Hayato steps in when he sees Kazuki trying to make a move on Haruki, who keeps dropping her nice girl facade.

episodes.title: You`re Special
episodes.overview: Hayato visits his mother in the hospital and then makes plans with Haruki and Himeko to go somewhere together.

episodes.title: Where the Heart Is
episodes.overview: Hayato, Haruki, and Himeko go to the movies as planned but end up catching an unexpected guest along the way.

episodes.title: Truly Special
episodes.overview: Haruki opens up about family issues after her rough night and Kazuki keeps trying to stir up drama at school.

episodes.title: We Are Friends, Right?
episodes.overview: Himeko sets up a group chat with Saki from Tsukinose and Hayato and his pals make plans for a day at the pool.

episodes.title: As Long As We`re Together
episodes.overview: Hayato and Haruki adjust to their new job and the girls shop for new swimsuits to wear on their big pool date.

episodes.title: A Fresh Start

titles.ja: これからの, 始まり

episodes.overview: Hayato and friends enjoy their long-awaited pool day and then take a trip to revisit their roots in Tsukinose.
